description: We are a multidisciplinary team combining Data Science, AI Engineering, Quality Assurance, UI/UX Design, and Business Strategy. We're building an interactive NASA-powered platform that makes Earth science accessible through data-driven investigations. Our strengths lie in scientific analysis, technical innovation, user-centred design, and product development. We value collaboration, creativity, and skills in geospatial analysis, visualization, and scientific storytelling. WE ARE COMING NASA!!!
